title: Episodic Consolidation Contract (Stage 4)
description: Request and response payload contracts for `sekha-cluster-tool consolidate`, dispatched to the Node 1 Long-Term Knowledge Graph Store (POST /api/v1/memory/consolidate, :8084). The response object is emitted verbatim to stdout by the CLI. Property names mirror the compiled tool's JSON tags exactly and must never be anglicised.

SensoryItem.description: A salient sensory chunk preserved in the episodic trace.

TrajectoryStep.description: A deliberate reasoning step recorded within the episodic trace.

request.description: Episodic trace committed to Node 1. Populated from the CLI flags --goal, --outcome, --session-id, --anchor, and --sync.

trace_id.description: Correlating distributed trace identifier; echoed from X-Trace-ID when omitted.

task_goal.description: The task the episode pursued (CLI flag --goal).

active_goal.description: The goal held in working memory at commit time.

outcome.description: Episode result (CLI flag --outcome; e.g. success, failure, partial).

sensory_context.description: Salient chunks preserved with the episode.

trajectory.description: Ordered reasoning steps of the episode.

synchronous.description: When true (CLI flag --sync), block until consolidation statistics are available; otherwise queue for background fusion and decay.

anchors.description: Anchor tags attached to committed entities (CLI flag --anchor / -a; repeatable or comma-delimited).

response.description: Ingestion receipt and consolidation statistics returned by Node 1.

trace_id.description: Trace identifier for the committed episode.

entities_extracted.description: Entities extracted from the trace (synchronous commits only).

nodes_fused.description: Existing graph nodes reinforced or merged (synchronous commits only).

edges_reinforced.description: Relational edges reinforced by Hebbian update (synchronous commits only).
